liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Casey Jones** (2 reviews): Opening seems hampered by sound or technical problems and lacks later power, but becomes a classic version once underway; Reviewer hears Jerry hinting at Proud Mary's melody in the opening minute, perhaps answering the White Rabbit requests [10][15]
- **Easy Wind** (2 reviews): Reviewer ranks this Easy Wind among the top five versions; Reviewer counts this among the best Easy Wind versions and calls the song a classic American tune [9][10]
- **Yellow Dog Story** (1 review, 1 other source): Reviewer says the text file raises a mystery about the Yellow Dog Story; Easy Wind runs continuously into Dark Star here, suggesting the Yellow Dog Story on the other source may be from another date [4][6]
- **Dark Star** (1 review): Reviewer says it starts with a rough splice, runs 17:22, and moves through many phases [14]

## Setlist highlights

- **lead in**: earliest performance in the archive; rare: 4 archived performances [18]

## The recordings

- **gd1969-09-01.157433.sbd.grner1.goody.1644** (recommended): soundboard; 12 songs; 123 min; rated 1/5 by 1 [1]
- **gd1969-09-01.sbd.kaplan.5216.shnf**: soundboard; 11 songs; 84 min; rated 3.6/5 by 5 [2]
- **gd1969-09-01.171656.BatonRougeLA.sbd.anon.gems.flac1644**: soundboard; 10 songs; 93 min; rated 4.75/5 by 4 [3]. Said about its sound: A splice leaves a brief gap after the start of Dark Star, and Lovelight has a few seconds of tape damage [3]
- **gd69-09-01.sbd.vernon.19963.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 9 songs; 94 min; rated 3.93/5 by 15 [4]. Said about its sound: Reviewer calls this an upgrade over earlier copies, with TC's organ adding a pleasant ambience to the music; Reviewer thinks TC is on organ for Dark Star and Pigpen on organ for Easy Wind [6][11]

## Around the show

- Reviewer cites an almanac saying temperatures hit 89 degrees that day, perhaps explaining the loose, strange feel of the show [11]
- Drunks kept shouting for White Rabbit during the Airplane's set and into the Dead's; Jerry said it wasn't their song [12]
- Bob suggested the hecklers listen to the record at home; audience members threw things to quiet them [12]
- Reviewer recalls the site is now single-family homes; in 1969 it hosted the New Orleans International Pop Festival, his first rock concert [13]
- Reviewer places the show at the first New Orleans Pop Festival, at a racetrack near Baton Rouge [17]
- The band played a first rock festival at a race track in Prairieville, Louisiana [3]
- Reviewer ranks this Dark Star possibly second best; looser than the 9/20/70 version, as Bobby's playing improved afterward [11]
- Differs from the earlier circulating copy: Casey Jones is not clipped and Yellow Dog Story is absent [4]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1969-09-01.157433.sbd.grner1.goody.1644**: transferred by Remaster by grner1, goody; source: Source 1 (unedited): cassette master > ? > CD's received in trade. Source 2 (edited): MSC (Ampex C-90 cassette) > DAT > CD-R (via Andy Lemieux and Kingbee). [1]. Also: About 14 minutes at the end of Lovelight was spliced in from the edited, known-lineage Source 2 because the unedited one was cut; A bonus folder holds the original spliced version, also properly tuned [1]
- **gd1969-09-01.sbd.kaplan.5216.shnf**: transferred by (Extraction and.shn encoding by Seth Kaplan via EAC and MKW.; source: SBD>Cm>Dat>CD [2]. Also: Reviewer complains this transfer adds a William Tell track and breaks the continuity between St. Stephen and The Eleven [16]
- **gd1969-09-01.171656.BatonRougeLA.sbd.anon.gems.flac1644**: taped by Recorded by Augustus Owsley Stanley III (aka Bear); transferred by Mastered by Jim Blackwood Speed/pitch adjusted by Jason Chastain Minor repairs, track, FLAC, and pack by Steve Gravel; source: Bear's Ampex Cassette Master > DAT > CD > WAV (provided by Anon) [3]. Also: Taken from a Tucson KXCI Dead Air broadcast hosted by Jim Blackwood, September 1, 2024; shared on shnflac in June 2025 [3]
- **gd69-09-01.sbd.vernon.19963.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Andy Lemieux, Kingbee, Matt Vernon; source: Soundboard [4]. Also: Reviewer says transcribers cut the stage banter between songs [12]

## Art and photos

- Poster by lostlivedead.blogspot.com: [Grateful Dead Performances At Race Tracks 1969-88](https://lostlivedead.blogspot.com/2013/07/grateful-dead-performances-at-race.html) [25]
